newsitem.title: UK: Colt has interconnect deal with Fr.Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Colt has interconnect deal with Fr.Telecom.

text.p: Colt Telecom Group Plc said on Friday that it has signed an agreement with France Telecom which provides it with access to the French telecommunication group's national network.
The agreement, through Colt's subsidiary COLT Telecommunications France, provides Colt with interconnect rates and allows the company to initiate the process of connecting to France Telecom switches.
COLT was granted a public licence in France in December 1996 and has since built a fibre optic network covering many of the main commercial areas in Paris and the La Defence office area.
